title: Overview
---

Every figure here is built from the Parquet logs under `data/runs/` when the site renders. Hover a point for its run and value.

```{python}
#| output: asis
from algoarcade.viz.site import connect, returns_figure, show

show(returns_figure(connect()))
```

The first logged episode of the first run, one frame per logged step.
